name: Bureaucrat
ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts as 3 votes tomorrow.
setup: Traveller: joins with an alignment chosen by the Storyteller; does not change the base character counts.
wakes: Every night, including the first. Night order: no number on the townsquare scale used by these specs (townsquare gives every Traveller a placeholder 1, and Fabled none); the official app nightsheet places it very early, before the Townsfolk (first night 11 of 80, other nights 7 of 99).
interaction: Points to any player other than themselves; that player is marked 3 VOTES and their votes the next day are counted aloud as three.
drunk_or_poisoned: The chosen player's vote counts as 1.

rulings.text: Applies to every vote the chosen player casts that day.
If the Bureaucrat dies (including by exile), the chosen player immediately loses the triple vote.
Exiles are not affected by abilities: the chosen player counts once for an exile.
A dead chosen player's single vote token counts as three.
Combined with the Thief on the same player, the vote counts as -3.

test_scenarios.name: triple vote
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Bureaucrat, Bob Chef, Carol Imp; 7 alive.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Alice chooses Bob. Day 1: Carol is nominated; Bob and one other vote.
test_scenarios.expected: Carol has 4 votes, meeting the threshold of 4.

test_scenarios.name: cannot choose self
test_scenarios.expected: Not allowed; Alice must choose another player.

test_scenarios.name: Bureaucrat exiled
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Alice is exiled; Bob then votes on a nomination.

test_scenarios.name: dead chosen player
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Bureaucrat, Bob dead with his vote token.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Alice chooses Bob. Day 2: Bob votes.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob's vote counts as 3 and his token is spent.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned Bureaucrat
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Bureaucrat, Dave Poisoner, Bob Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Dave poisons Alice; Alice chooses Bob. Day 2: Bob votes.
